name: DawaaGuard
description: DawaaCheck QA Team - 5 AI agents monitoring the app 24/7

flutter-skill.comment: E2E testing for Flutter apps - used by Jaanch agent

scheduling.note: Paperclip drives the heartbeat for every agent (see paperclip/.paperclip.yaml). The schedules below are the source of truth for cadence; OpenClaw's own cron is left off so the two schedulers cannot double-fire an agent. To run OpenClaw standalone, move this block to a top-level "cron" key.

nizam-patrol.prompt: Run a full code patrol check on the DawaaCheck codebase. Check flutter analyze, design system violations, and Python backend compilation.

talash-hunt.prompt: Run a deep bug hunt on the DawaaCheck codebase. Check for logic bugs, edge cases, null safety issues, and potential crashes in both Flutter and backend agents.

nigran-health.prompt: Check all DawaaCheck backend API endpoints. Report health status, response times, and any errors.

muhafiz-audit.comment: Daily at 10 PM PKT (system time) - Security audit
muhafiz-audit.prompt: Run a full security audit on the DawaaCheck codebase. Check for hardcoded secrets, vulnerabilities, OWASP compliance, and dependency issues.

budget.note: Agents pause for the rest of the UTC day once the cap is hit; the next window resumes them.
